channel.title: AI Builder's Field Guide — Recently Added
channel.description: A daily-curated wiki of the tools, models, and patterns that AI power-users and builders actually reach for.

item.title: SiliconFlow
item.description: SiliconFlow is an AI cloud platform designed for running, customizing, and scaling large language models and multimodal models with high reliability and managed infrastructure. — It provides optimized inference, a simple fine-tuning pipeline, and fully managed deployment, offering a specialized alternative to general cloud providers for hosting open-weight models in production.

item.title: Cloudflare Computer
item.description: Cloudflare Computer is a TypeScript repository providing an environment for AI agents to interact with a simulated computer, enabling them to perceive, decide, and act. — It offers a sandbox for developing and testing autonomous agents that require complex system interactions, facilitating the creation of more capable AI systems beyond typical API calls.

item.title: TencentDB Agent Memory
item.description: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub that transforms conversations, documents, and code into reusable memory assets for AI agents. — It offers a structured approach to shared agent memory across teams and frameworks, distinguishing itself from single-agent memory solutions.

item.title: Kimi K3
item.description: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3, a 2.8 trillion parameter multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with a 1 million token context window. — Kimi K3 sets a new benchmark for open-weight models, offering frontier-level reasoning and multimodal capabilities that were previously limited to closed-source models. It provides a powerful alternative to models like Claude Fable 5 for complex coding and agentic tasks.

item.title: Mistral Medium 3.5
item.description: Mistral Medium 3.5 is a new open-weight model family designed for building customizable and deployable AI applications. — This provides developers with a powerful, efficient, and open-weight alternative to proprietary models, offering greater control over deployment and data.

item.title: Grok Build
item.description: Grok Build is xAI's open-source coding agent CLI and terminal UI, providing transparency into Grok's coding stack and supporting context handling and tool execution. — It allows engineers to study a production-grade coding agent harness line by line, offering insights into xAI's agent loop, unlike closed-source alternatives.

item.title: GLM 5.2
item.description: GLM 5.2 is Zhipu AI's flagship open-weight model for long-horizon tasks, offering advanced coding capabilities and a solid 1M-token context window. — It provides a high-performing, open-source alternative to proprietary frontier models, enabling on-premise deployment for sensitive tasks like security forensics.

item.title: Artifacts by Databox
item.description: Artifacts by Databox generates polished reports, slide decks, or interactive documents from live business data using an AI Analyst. — It streamlines the creation of data-driven reports by turning AI analyst conversations into shareable documents, reducing manual dashboard building and analysis.
